wpl2.title: Building a customer insights dashboard during my Work Placement 2.
wpl2.meta: 12 weeks · Front-end internship · A mid-sized SaaS company in Hasselt

sections.title: Case description
paragraphs: During my second Work Placement at a SaaS company specializing in customer engagement software, I joined the product team responsible for a new analytics product.
The existing internal tools were powerful but technical. The goal was to expose data through a self-serve dashboard with sensible defaults, fast filters, and clean visualizations.
I joined at the start of the build phase. The design system existed in Figma but had only been partially implemented in code.

sections.title: My contribution
paragraphs: I was responsible for the dashboard's filter system and a set of three core visualization components: a trend line, a segmented bar chart, and a cohort heatmap.
I worked closely with the product designer to refine interactions, and paired with two senior developers during code review.
I wrote the internal documentation for the chart library and presented a short demo at the bi-weekly product showcase.

sections.title: What I learned
list: Designing for ambiguity — empty states and slow networks are the default, not edge cases.
Code review as a tool — smaller, focused pull requests win.
Async communication — write updates that don't require a follow-up call.
The cost of opinions — architectural decisions have real trade-offs.

sections.title: Final result
paragraphs: The dashboard shipped to a closed beta of 40 customers two weeks before my placement ended. Early feedback was positive.
deliverables: 3 production-ready chart components with Storybook documentation
Reusable filter system with URL-state sync
Internal chart library README and contribution guide
Final reflection report (PDF) and slide deck
